test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Name the state that became the first state to introduce carbon-neutral farming methods, in March 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Kerala__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Carbon-neutral farming methods in Kerala**

 
 
• **​**In some areas, the state will implement carbon-neutral farming methods, for which the government has **allocated 6 crores in the budget for 2022-23.**
 
• **13 farms** will use carbon-neutral farming in the first phase, and efforts are being made to make the **State Seed Farm in Aluva** a carbon-neutral farm.
 
• Model carbon-neutral farms will be built in each of the **140 Assembly constituencies** during the second phase.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Importance of Carbon-Neutral Farming Methods**

 
 
• **Agriculture** that doesn't use carbon is becoming more and more important to keep the environment in balance,** improve people's health**, and provide safe food for future generations.
 
• As the recent unpredictability of** heavy rain and flooding** indicate, Kerala is experiencing the effects of** climate change and global warming.**
 
• The state must implement **new and creative agricultural methods** in this circumstance.
 
• Agriculture that is carbon neutral would help the **soil store carbon and reduce carbon emissions.**
